build-pi: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm GOARM=6 go build -o epd-armv6 .
deploy: if [ -z "${PI_HOST}" ]; then echo 'EPD_DEVICE not set (expected host:port)'; exit 1; fi
CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm GOARM=6 go build -o epd-armv6 .
ssh pi@${PI_HOST} 'sudo mv /tmp/epd-new /usr/local/bin/epd && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/epd && sudo systemctl restart epd && sudo systemctl status epd --no-pager'
